scene.about: Step 1. One picture that every style redraws. Fill in the three brackets.
scene.prompt: Make a vertical 9:16 image. One subject: [who, what they wear]. One pose: [what they are doing, caught mid-action]. A simple background: [two or three things, e.g. a grassy cliff, the sea, one kite in a blue sky]. Full body in frame, subject centred, clear empty sky above. Bright, clean cartoon illustration. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

restyle.about: Step 2. Run once per style, always on the same scene picture.
restyle.template: Redraw the scene in the last image as {style}. Keep the exact same subject, pose, camera angle and layout, and the same colours wherever the style allows. {look} Vertical 9:16. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

animate.about: Step 3. Turn each styled picture into a short clip.
animate.template: Animate this image into a 3 second clip (use the shortest length the tool allows). The camera stays completely still. Only small movements: {motion}. Keep the {style} look in every frame. No text.
animate.motion: the subject bobs gently at the top of the action, hair and clothes move a little, background details sway, clouds drift slowly

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.look: 16-bit pixel art from a 1990s console game: chunky square pixels you can see, a limited palette of about 32 colours, hard edges with no blur or smoothing, a simple dithered sky.

styles.name: Claymation
styles.look: Stop-motion claymation: every object sculpted from matte plasticine with fingerprints and tool marks, soft studio light, a little tilt-shift depth of field, a handmade feel.

styles.name: Toy bricks
styles.look: Built entirely from plastic toy construction bricks, the person as a small block-built toy figure, glossy studs on every brick, brick clouds and brick grass, macro toy-photography lighting. No brand names or logos.

styles.name: Comic book
styles.look: A classic comic book panel: bold black ink outlines, flat bright colours, halftone dots in the shading, a jagged action burst behind the subject. No speech bubbles, no sound words, no text.

styles.name: Paper cutout
styles.look: Layered paper cutout craft: every shape cut from coloured card with visible paper fibres, soft drop shadows between the layers, shallow depth like a shadow box seen from the front.

styles.name: Retro anime
styles.look: 1990s hand-painted cel anime: clean ink lines, two-tone cel shading, a soft painted watercolour sky, warm film grain and slightly faded colours.

styles.name: Low poly
styles.look: A low poly 3D render: everything made of flat-shaded triangles, simple faceted clouds, soft pastel light, a clean toy-like finish.

styles.name: Knitted wool
styles.look: Knitted and crocheted wool: every surface made of yarn stitches with visible knit texture, felt clouds, a cosy handmade-toy look in soft daylight.

styles.name: Risograph
styles.look: A two-colour risograph print: only fluorescent pink and blue ink on off-white paper, grainy texture, the two colour layers slightly out of register, paper showing through.

styles.name: Miniature diorama
styles.look: A handmade miniature diorama on a wooden tabletop: a tiny painted figure, model-railway grass, cotton-wool clouds on thin wires, shot with a macro lens and strong tilt-shift blur, a real room softly out of focus behind.
